taiwan_aviation.headline: 長榮航前9月營收創新高 油價仍為營運最大變數
taiwan_aviation.summary: 長榮航空總經理孫嘉明表示，雖然調漲票價與運價帶動營收創下新高，但高漲的航空燃油成本仍是獲利的最大變數。受地緣政治風險影響，先前國際航線航空燃油價格已達到每桶約177美元，使得航空業面臨龐大的營利壓力。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: EVA Air Reports Record Nine-Month Revenue as High Fuel Prices Impact Profits
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: EVA Air General Manager Sun Chia-ming stated that while increases in passenger fares and cargo freight rates have driven overall revenues to record highs, rising jet fuel costs remain the largest variable affecting annual profitability. Due to geopolitical risks, international jet fuel prices previously reached approximately $177 per barrel, significantly impacting industry operating margins.

international_aviation.headline: 美航南本德—芝加哥84英里接駁改由CRJ-700執飛、班次減半
international_aviation.summary: 美國航空已把印第安納州南本德地區機場與芝加哥歐海爾國際機場之間的接駁，從Landline巴士改為噴射機。根據WNDU報導，這項轉換於2026年10月生效；巴士時期旅客在小型機場報到、通過安檢後搭車前往歐海爾機場管制區內的登機門，行李可直掛最終目的地，巴士本身還帶有航班編號並可累積哩程。這條僅84英里（135公里）的路線改由天西航空以美國之鷹名義執飛的龐巴迪CRJ-700執飛，每日3班往返，飛行時間約1小時15分鐘，較巴士約2小時45分鐘省下約一個半小時。
international_aviation.headline_en: American Airlines swaps its 84-mile South Bend bus for CRJ-700 jets — and halves departures
international_aviation.summary_en: American Airlines has replaced buses with jets on the 84-mile (135 km) link between South Bend Regional Airport in Indiana and Chicago O'Hare International Airport (ORD), switching to the aircraft link in October 2026, according to WNDU. Under the Landline arrangement, passengers checked in at the small airport, cleared TSA screening there and rode to a secure-side gate at O'Hare, with bags checked through to the final destination, and the coach carried a flight number and earned AAdvantage miles. The new service is operated by SkyWest Airlines as American Eagle with dual-class Bombardier CRJ-700 regional jets, offering three daily round trips and a blocked time of about 1 hour 15 minutes, roughly an hour and a half less than the bus.

international_aviation.headline: 為什麼每架A350都只能用同一款發動機：奇異不願為A350-1000造發動機，勞斯萊斯獨家供應至2030年
international_aviation.summary: 空中巴士至今生產的每一架A350都使用同一款發動機。量產十多年、客戶超過60家航空公司，沒有任何業者有選擇餘地，這與波音777與787夢幻客機不同，後兩者讓客戶在奇異與勞斯萊斯之間選擇。這並非空中巴士的偏好：奇異原本願意為A350-900供應發動機，卻拒絕為加長型的A350-1000打造發動機，因為該機型直接與奇異動力的波音777競爭。奇異不願涵蓋全系列之後，勞斯萊斯成為唯一願意專為該機型開發發動機的製造商，相關安排也已透過合約鎖定至2030年。
international_aviation.headline_en: Why every A350 flies on one engine: GE walked away from the A350-1000, leaving Rolls-Royce alone until 2030
international_aviation.summary_en: Every Airbus A350 ever built flies with the same engine. Over more than a decade of production and with more than 60 airline customers, no operator has had a choice, a contrast with the Boeing 777 and 787 Dreamliner, which offer customers a choice between General Electric and Rolls-Royce engines. That outcome was not Airbus' preference: General Electric was prepared to supply an engine for the A350-900 and refused to build one for the stretched A350-1000, because the larger aircraft competes directly against the GE-powered Boeing 777. With GE unwilling to cover the full family, Rolls-Royce became the only manufacturer willing to develop an engine specifically for the aircraft, and the arrangement has since been locked in by contract through 2030.

international_aviation.headline: B-21對比B-2、B-52與B-1B：隱形、架構與規模決定下一代轟炸機主力
international_aviation.summary: 美國空軍數十年來使用同一批三款轟炸機：波音B-52H同溫層堡壘、洛克威爾B-1槍騎兵與諾斯洛普格魯曼B-2幽靈。每款都在近年的作戰中證明過價值，但也各有難以突破的上限：結構老化、面對同級威脅的存活能力，或是升級成本已經高到難以負擔。諾斯洛普格魯曼B-21突襲者的設計目標就是沒有同等的上限，要一次解決這三個問題。
international_aviation.headline_en: How the B-21 Raider compares to the B-2 Spirit, B-52 and B-1B — and why it wins every category
international_aviation.summary_en: The United States Air Force has flown the same three bomber platforms for decades: the Boeing B-52H Stratofortress, the Rockwell B-1 Lancer and the Northrop Grumman B-2 Spirit. Each has proved its relevance in recent operations, but each also carries a hard ceiling defined by structural age, survivability against peer-level threats, or an architecture that has become prohibitively expensive to upgrade. The Northrop Grumman B-21 Raider was designed to have no equivalent ceiling, and it is the Air Force's answer to all three problems at once.
